what_you_believe_happened: Signed in as accounts.audit, opened Money, clicked '+ New vendor', filled vendor name, GST treatment (Registered - Regular), GSTIN, PAN, TDS section 194C (Contractor), payment terms 30, and clicked 'Send vendor for approval'. A toast 'Vendor draft #9 sent for approval.' appeared, the form reset, and the Inbox badge showed 1. The vendor is therefore a draft awaiting approval, not yet an active vendor; I did not verify it elsewhere.
unnecessary_steps: Had to scroll down to find the submit button
Dropdown options could not be chosen by mouse click; needed keyboard arrows
confusing_terminology: Zoho-style vendor profile -> refers to another product, meaningless to a new user
Send vendor for approval / approval ticket -> not clear the vendor is not yet active
missing_feedback: Toast is small, bottom-right, and disappears; does not say where to track the approval or link to the ticket
Form stays open and resets silently after submit; no confirmation of what was saved
No indication of which approver will see it
unexpected_behaviour: Clicking an option in the native dropdown lists did not select it (GST treatment and TDS stayed unchanged); keyboard ArrowDown+Enter worked
Payment terms field was prefilled with a real value 30 (my typing made 3030), while it looks similar to placeholders
Page scrolled by itself when tabbing
visual_issues: Placeholder example text (29ABCDE1234F1Z5, ABCDE1234F, 9876543210, 29, HDFC0001234) looks nearly like real values, so hard to tell filled from empty
Prefilled payment terms 30 looks like a placeholder
accessibility_issues: Mouse clicks on dropdown options did not register, so keyboard needed
Placeholders low contrast and resemble real entries
Form submit button is below the fold with no sticky action
observations: The path was easy to find: Money, then the clearly labelled '+ New vendor' button at the top. The form is clear with required markers. Main weakness is ambiguity between placeholders and real values, and the thin post-submit feedback.
